info: An ionic bond forms when electrons are transferred from one atom to another, producing oppositely charged ions. In sodium chloride formation, a sodium atom transfers one electron to a chlorine atom. Sodium becomes a positively charged sodium ion (Na+), while chlorine becomes a negatively charged chloride ion (Cl-). The oppositely charged ions attract each other strongly through electrostatic forces and form a repeating crystal lattice structure, producing sodium chloride (NaCl).
